caseNameFull: In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Howard Neil SHIPLEY.

opinions.text: Howard Neil Shipley, of Washington, District of Columbia, is ordered to show *780cause, within 40 days, why he should not be sanctioned for his conduct as a member of the Bar of this Court in connection with the petition No. 14-424, Sigram Schindler Beteiligungsgesellschaft MBH v. Lee.
